description: Metricairn browser tracking snippet; no cookies, browser-local random IDs
name: @metricairn/tracker

scripts.build: tsup src/tracker.ts --format iife --global-name metricairn --minify --clean --out-dir dist && mv dist/tracker.global.js dist/metricairn.js
scripts.dev: tsup src/tracker.ts --format iife --watch --out-dir dist --onSuccess 'mv dist/tracker.global.js dist/metricairn.js'
